div.div: 罗马共和国如何运作 · 509–27 BC

div.div:
2 Consuls 执政官
Lead the government and the army.
Chosen for one year. Each one can block (veto) the other.

div.div:
Senate 元老院
About 300 powerful men, members for life.
Advise the consuls. Control money and talks with other countries.

div.div:
Citizen assemblies 公民大会
Roman citizens vote: they elect the consuls every year,
and vote on laws and on going to war.
